evals.name: per-screen-source-comparison
evals.prompt: Vérifie un prototype de réservation en quatre écrans contre la planche de parcours et les quatre sources détaillées approuvées.
evals.expected_output: Compare every implementation state with its corresponding detailed source and separately verify end-to-end continuity; do not use the board alone.

evals.name: no-browser-block
evals.prompt: Le build réussit mais aucun navigateur ni capture de l'implémentation n'est disponible.
evals.expected_output: Write a blocked verdict and refuse visual verification claims.

evals.name: qa-not-user-research
evals.prompt: La QA visuelle est passée. Peut-on dire que l'expérience est validée par les utilisateurs ?
evals.expected_output: Clearly separate fidelity/execution evidence from usability or desirability validation.

evals.name: traced-value-intent-rendered-task
evals.subject: experience-qa
evals.prompt: @Product Design vérifie notre prototype dossier : sources et rendu au même état sont disponibles, blueprint lie valeur utilisateur, explication locale, filtre réversible, préparation native et résultat. Décris la vérification à effectuer.
evals.expected_output: A source/rendered comparison and task-validity plan tracing concrete design consequences; no completed QA claim from prose.
assertions: Compares each implemented state to its approved source at the same viewport/state
Checks intent placement, direct controls, context/return and manual edits against the blueprint
Separates execution/test validity from measured usability or product value

evals.name: beautiful-rendered-source-effect-drift
evals.subject: experience-qa
evals.prompt: Les captures montrent que notre prototype est beau et ressemble aux sources, mais un filtre déclenche un envoi externe et une préparation est présentée comme livrée. Quel verdict Product Design ?
evals.expected_output: Blocked on material intent/effect differences despite visual fidelity.
assertions: Blocks QA on no-effect view violations or false delivered state
Names affected source/implemented states and a targeted fix/recomparison
Does not let visual fidelity compensate for task/state errors

evals.name: missing-capture-not-ux-validation
evals.subject: experience-qa
evals.prompt: Le code compile et le brief reprend tous nos tableaux. Aucune capture du rendu n’est disponible. Peut-on annoncer QA et amélioration de productivité ?
evals.expected_output: Blocked rendered-source QA and unmeasured value, not a completed UX claim.
assertions: Missing rendered visual evidence blocks QA
Build success or presence of feedback text is not fidelity/interaction evidence
Does not claim usability or productivity improvement without observed user/operational evidence
